name: alberta-buck-kernel
description: Alberta Buck monetary and identity kernels as WebAssembly: integer money arithmetic bit-identical to the Solidity contracts, and the BN254 identity/wallet cryptography, for Node and the browser
author: Perry Kundert <perry@dominionrnd.com>
//files: node/ and web/ are build outputs and therefore gitignored; npm falls back to .gitignore when there is no .npmignore, so they MUST be listed here or the published tarball ships no wasm at all.
//exports: Two builds of the same kernels: node/ is CommonJS (wasm-pack --target nodejs, loaded with createRequire), web/ is ESM (--target web, awaits an explicit wasm source). The bare subpaths pick by environment; the node/ and web/ subpaths force one.
